title: Some common themes and places from my dream world
content: I used Gemini to recreate some of the most common places I go to when I dream. My mall world with some type of performance or theater, parking lot scene trying to find my car, waiting for a performance to start trying to get a good view, all usually at night or when the mall is near closing.. other themes I have frequently are the bathroom scene with dirty or broken stalls, driving long ways either to an airport or through a new city, a house or apartment that I’m either moving into or renting with other people in a common area. Some of the more vivid dreams I recall are when I’m trying to escape or get out of the mall while trying to remain unseen or hiding from someone/something.. going through back doors, alleyways, secret or unknown exits and coming up with a plan to get to get away. Sometimes I’m with others although can’t remember or know who. Rarely I think I become close to lucid dreaming when I recognize I’m dreaming and try to explore and take “control”. I just recently found out about this sub and the resemblance in other people’s dream experiences is crazy.
